end.line: Quillon for Graystone Capital’s deal team

vo: Graystone Capital closes about twenty-five acquisitions a year, and the investment committee wants red-flag memos in forty-eight hours.
Load a data room of ten thousand documents into Vault. Every one is read at once, and change of control terms come back flagged.
Quillon builds the deal chronology from the diligence record, and every event links back to its source document.
Ask the Assistant for the memo's red flags, and every answer is cited to the page.
Claire will walk your team through it on Friday the thirteenth.
